detection.summary: The router heartbeat is stale at 7.4 hours, although the OLT and sampled customer line remain operational with normal optical readings and recent traffic.

diagnosis.root_cause: The router heartbeat is stale at 7.4 hours, exceeding the 4-hour danger threshold. The OLT and sampled ONU are healthy and passing traffic, isolating the issue to router reachability or heartbeat reporting rather than EPON service.
evidence: Router heartbeat age is 7.4 hours with heartbeat_status=danger; danger begins above 4 hours.
The OLT responds to ping and SNMP, with its OID subtree responding, so the OLT is not unreachable.
The sampled ONU is online with responds=true, RX power -20.61 dBm, TX power 2.4 dBm, and completed authentication.
The sampled customer has recent traffic and only 1 session in the last 24 hours, with an average duration of 701 minutes.
Optical readings are stable over 168 hours: RX change -0.05 dBm, TX change -0.09 dBm, constant distance of 152 m, and stable TX bias current.
The RADIUS entry exists and is CRM-consistent, ruling out a missing or inconsistent authentication record.

escalation.review_reason: The stale heartbeat may reflect router reachability or a fault in the router health-check/monitoring system. OLT and ONU service are healthy with recent traffic, so verify the router and heartbeat monitoring before taking action; no EPON repair is indicated.
escalation.summary: The router heartbeat has been stale for 7.4 hours, exceeding the danger threshold, but the OLT and sampled ONU are online, have normal optical readings, and are passing traffic. Treat this as a monitoring or router-reachability warning with no current customer service impact. NOC should verify live router reachability and correct the heartbeat monitoring record if reporting is stale.

ground_truth.root_cause: The BNG TK_AZ_Bitola_Jadranska01 stopped checking in 7.4 hours ago. Customers behind it lost their sessions at the same moment. The optical plant is entirely unaffected: ONUs remain registered and are returning normal signal readings.
expected_reasoning: Router heartbeat is 7.4 hours stale, past the 4 hour danger threshold
The ONU is online with RX -20.6 and TX 2.4, both normal, and the live probe confirms it
Every peer on the port is also online with normal optical readings
OLT ping, SNMP and device metrics are all healthy
So the optical layer is working and the fault is not in the fibre plant
Sessions across customers on this router ended together 7.4 hours ago
Throughput fell to zero at the same moment while the ONUs stayed registered
Healthy ONUs with dead sessions is the router signature: the optical layer carries no traffic without the BNG
The blast radius follows the router, not the OLT, so every customer it serves is affected
distractors: ONU status is online everywhere, inviting a no_fault conclusion
The OLT health check reports healthy, which is correct but irrelevant
Optical readings are perfect, which points away from where the fault is
